visibility: Host only; receiver gets the common contract, not these concrete fixtures or grader feedback.

cases.input: full SHA of a second commit with the same tree
cases.expect: same exact bytes; no requirement that revision equals HEAD

cases.input: full SHA of annotated tag object targeting commit_a
full SHA of annotated tag targeting another annotated tag
fixed 40-hex SHA confirmed absent by fixture setup
valid commit SHA, path naming a tree
HEAD, uppercase SHA, short SHA and non-string values

primary_outcome: One binary success per session: all cases pass and only permitted production file changed. Individual case counts are diagnostics, not independent samples.
grader_limit: 10 seconds per case; exception other than the named Refusal, wrong bytes, timeout or missing submission fails that case.
required_before_execution: Deterministic fixture generator and grader implementation must be committed and reviewed; baseline and a host-only reference fix must be checked offline before any model session. This specification alone is not a validated grader.
